title: The Pirate Treasure Nobody Came Back For
description:
Captain Mara buried her treasure on Skull Beach in 1720 and never came back. One cabin boy kept the map his whole life.

#shorts #pirates #treasure #story

scenes.title: she never came back
scenes.voice: Captain Mara buried her treasure on Skull Beach in 1720. She never came back for it. Nobody knows why.

shots.image_prompt: Pirate captain Mara, red bandana and long dark braid, burying a wooden treasure chest on a golden beach at sunset, palm trees, her red-sailed ship anchored in the turquoise bay
shots.caption: SHE NEVER CAME BACK

shots.image_prompt: The same pirate captain Mara in her red bandana walking away along the shoreline at dusk, deep footprints in the wet sand, the beach empty behind her
The same golden beach at night, empty under a big moon, silver light on the sand and one low mound where the chest is buried, calm dark waves

scenes.title: the fastest ship
scenes.voice: Her ship, the Red Gull, was the fastest in the Caribbean. Forty pirates, one parrot, and a map that only Mara could read.

shots.image_prompt: The Red Gull, a pirate ship with bright red sails, racing over turquoise waves under a clear sky, captain Mara in her red bandana at the wheel
shots.caption: THE RED GULL

shots.image_prompt: Pirates in striped shirts hauling ropes on the deck of the same red-sailed ship, a green parrot on the rail, spray flying over the side
Captain Mara in her red bandana studying a hand-drawn map in her lantern-lit cabin, the green parrot watching from the back of a chair

scenes.title: three days of storm
scenes.voice: Then came the storm. Three days of black waves and lightning. The Red Gull went down with everyone on board, except one cabin boy.

shots.image_prompt: The red-sailed pirate ship Red Gull tossed by huge black waves in a night storm, lightning splitting the purple sky, torn sails
shots.caption: THREE DAYS OF STORM

shots.image_prompt: Huge black waves breaking over the deck of the same ship at night, pirates clinging to the ropes, rain sheeting across the lanterns
A young cabin boy in a striped shirt alone on a broken plank in the dark sea at first light, wreckage and a torn red sail floating nearby

scenes.title: the same beach
scenes.voice: That boy grew old with the map in his pocket. He drew it a hundred times, and every copy pointed to the same beach.

shots.image_prompt: An old sailor with a white beard, the grown-up cabin boy, unrolling a worn treasure map on a table in a lantern-lit room, warm candlelight
shots.caption: A HUNDRED COPIES

shots.image_prompt: A wooden table covered with dozens of hand-drawn copies of the same treasure map, ink pot and quill, the old sailor's hands over them
Close view of one worn map in candlelight, a curved golden beach with three palm trees and a black cross inked into the sand

scenes.title: still there?
scenes.voice: So is the treasure still there? Follow, and next time we dig up Skull Beach.

shots.image_prompt: Golden beach at dawn with a half-buried wooden treasure chest spilling gold coins into the sand, a shovel beside it, palm trees, calm turquoise sea
